name: WF 7 - Travelistguide — Posts pending to Postiz (Facebook + Instagram)

parameters.content:
## WF7 — Posts pending ➜ Postiz (Facebook + Instagram)
Publishes **exactly** what WF4 wrote to the *Posts pending* tab.

**Setup (once)**
1. In the *Posts pending* tab add 4 header cells after the existing ones:
`FB_Scheduled_For | IG_Scheduled_For | Postiz_IDs | Publish_Log`
(Status already exists — WF7 overwrites it.)
2. Postiz ➜ Settings ➜ Public API ➜ copy the key.
n8n credential **Header Auth** named `Postiz API`:
Name `Authorization` · Value `<your key>` (no "Bearer").
Select it on the 3 orange Postiz nodes.
3. **Config** ➜ set `postiz_base` = `https://<your-postiz-domain>/api/public/v1` and `timezone` = your audience's timezone.
FB/IG channels are auto-detected from Postiz.
4. Test with `post_type: 'draft'` first, then switch to `schedule`.

**Status flow:** Pending (WF4) ➜ [Approved if require_approval] ➜ Scheduled / Posted / Postiz Draft / Partial / Error.
Rows with Postiz_IDs are never posted twice. To retry an Error row: fix it, set Status back to Pending.

## Platform rules applied automatically
**Facebook** — lunchtime slot · post body from `Facebook_Post` · 1-3 hashtags · ends on WF4's question (comments) · links stripped from body (reach penalty) ➜ optional `facebook_link` goes in the first comment.

**Instagram** — evening slot · `Instagram_Caption` · hook must fit before the "...more" cut (~125 chars, else WF4's Hook is put on top) · save/share CTA appended · max 5 hashtags (Instagram's cap): 3 niche + 1 broad + brand.

**Both** — never the same minute (staggered + random jitter) · one post/day/platform by default · queue continues after the last scheduled post, max 7 days ahead · highest Awareness_Score first.

**YouTube** — video only: Postiz can't put an image on YouTube ➜ handled by the Shorts workflow (WF6).

parameters.jsCode:
// ===================== EDIT THESE =====================
return [{ json: {
  // Your Postiz in Coolify + /api/public/v1  (Postiz > Settings > Public API gives the key)
  postiz_base: 'https://postiz.YOUR-DOMAIN.com/api/public/v1',

  // Timezone of your AUDIENCE (not your server). IANA name.
  timezone: 'Europe/London',

  post_type: 'schedule',      // schedule | now | draft  (draft = lands in Postiz for a final look)
  require_approval: false,    // true = only rows whose Status you changed to "Approved" get posted

  posts_per_run: 3,           // how many sheet rows to queue per run
  max_days_ahead: 7,          // never queue further out than this
  facebook_times: ['12:30'],  // one entry per post per day, local time. 2/day: ['09:00','15:00']
  instagram_times: ['19:00'], // same length as facebook_times.            2/day: ['12:00','20:00']
  jitter_minutes: 12,         // random 0-12 min offset so posts don't land on robotic :00 / :30

  brand_hashtag: '#travelistguide',
  instagram_max_hashtags: 5,  // Instagram caps posts at 5 hashtags
  facebook_max_hashtags: 3,   // Facebook: 1-3 hashtags, more looks spammy
  facebook_link: '',          // optional URL -> posted as the FIRST COMMENT, never in the post body

  platforms: ['facebook', 'instagram'],
  facebook_integration_id: '',  // blank = auto-detect from Postiz
  instagram_integration_id: ''  // blank = auto-detect from Postiz
}}];
